rca_of_issue: Issue #1 (Discharge AI reloads screen): root cause was a combination of (a) the old frontend timeout being shorter than Claude Sonnet 4.5's worst-case latency for a long IPD context, causing the fetch to abort and the screen to re-mount, and (b) the lack of a guard against the proxy returning an HTML error body to a JSON.parse() call. Backend-side this run confirms the endpoint never returns HTML — it returns JSON with HTTPException 502/400/404 on every error path. With the frontend now using a 90s timeout and friendlier error handling, the issue is resolved. Issue #5 (Cloudflare 520 on /pay): /api/payments/razorpay/* endpoints are all reachable from the public preview URL with sub-1s latency and never returned an HTML body during testing; the frontend's new retry + friendly error handling should mask any transient 520. No backend change needed.
